# Gasses 5 Rare, incredibly niche gasses and materials that are primarily novelties for the advanced atmosians.
## Anti-Noblium
An incredibly light gas that interacts with absolutely nothing.
Anti-noblium can be made by electrolyzing hyper-noblium.
## Zauker
An incredibly difficult to synthesize gas that is highly unstable and incredibly toxic.
Although lethality is largely limited by zauker's propensity to decay in presence of nitrogen, directly breathing it rapidly destroys one's life expectancy.
Zauker can be made by combining 50 nitrium with 1 hyper-noblium at between 50000 K and 100000 K.
## Metal Hydrogen
Impossibly dense hydrogen kept stable by BZ.
Though dense, metal hydrogen is malleable enough to be worked with common tools into incredibly durable items.
Metal hydrogen ingots are formed by combining 300 mols hydrogen and 50 mols BZ on a tile at over 10000 kpa and under 273 K.
